user.title: Set up local weather forecast
user.description:
Select the sensors of your weather station. Pressure and temperature are required; wind bearing noticeably improves the result.

Important: for pressure, pick the RELATIVE pressure of your gateway (already reduced to sea level). Only enable the switch below if you deliberately picked the absolute pressure.

data.name: Name
data.pressure_is_absolute: The selected sensor reports absolute pressure

data_description.pressure_sensor: On an Ecowitt gateway (e.g. GW2000) this entity is usually named "Relative pressure".
data_description.pressure_is_absolute: Only enable if you deliberately chose absolute pressure. Reduction to sea level then uses the elevation from the options.
data_description.wind_bearing_sensor: In degrees (0-360). The algorithm works without it, but less accurately.
data_description.rain_rate_sensor: In mm/h. Used to show the measured state instead of the forecast while it is actually raining.
data_description.solar_sensor: In W/m² or lux. Lets the current condition be measured instead of derived from the forecast, which is considerably more accurate.

error.not_numeric: This entity currently does not report a numeric value.

abort.already_configured: A forecast for this pressure sensor already exists.

data_description.trend_hours: Period used to compute the pressure trend. The classic algorithm is designed around 3 hours.
data_description.update_interval: How often the forecast is recalculated. More often than every few minutes gains nothing, as pressure changes slowly.
data_description.elevation: Only needed when using absolute pressure. Prefilled from your Home Assistant configuration.
data_description.solar_sensor: Can be added here if the integration was set up before version 0.3.0.
data_description.solar_calibration: If cloud cover is reported on cloudless days, your sensor reads low: set below 1. If it reports sunny under an overcast sky, set above 1.
